study_identification_part.si_4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Discovery dataset (First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University) and replication dataset (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China/Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute); no special dataset names reported.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Two independent datasets were included in this study: a discovery dataset ... and a replication dataset..."; "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University."; "In the replication dataset, 106 patients with depression were recruited from the Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Main analyses were based on the discovery dataset and reproduced on the replication dataset; normative model trained on HCs in each dataset.
